column1: # Published metrics for Puccinia triticina 19NSW04, from Sperschneider et al., Nat Microbiol
# 2023, doi:10.1038/s41564-023-01494-9, and the NCBI assembly GCA_029633885.1 (chromosome
# lengths computed from its sequence report). Reference targets for the validation run.
# HOW TO COMPARE. The B and C haplotypes are Hi-C SCAFFOLDED to 18 chromosomes each (SALSA,
# then joined by eye from contact maps); this pipeline emits CONTIGS unless Hi-C is supplied.
# Comparable without scaffolding: assembly_size (against the paper's 123-129 Mb raw
# haplotypes), contigs. Not comparable until the Hi-C branch runs: chromosomes,
# scaffold_n50, scaffold_l50, max_scaffold.
# NOT comparable at all: BUSCO. The paper ran BUSCO v3.0.2 on basidiomycota_odb9 and reports
# only ">95% complete, <5% duplicated" per haplotype in the text (exact values are in its
# Supplementary Table, not transcribed here).
# Their method, for a like-for-like run: hifiasm 0.16.1, Hi-C integration mode, default
# parameters, 15.2 Gb HiFi + 34.8 Gb Hi-C. Contaminant, <5x-coverage and mitochondrial
# contigs removed. conf/pt.config matches the hifiasm choice.
# unplaced is the 123 small sequences (7.17 Mb) left outside the chromosomes: mostly
# repeats and rDNA per the paper. It is not a target.
